compat.missing_data.context: any rule: a spec value the rule needs is unknown. {field} is already the display name of the field (compat.field.<category>.<field>, picked by the caller from the issue params field and category), not the technical key; the guillemets are part of the text

compat.socket_mismatch.context: CPU_MB_SOCKET, block: the processor socket differs from the motherboard socket; values like AM5, LGA1700

compat.chipset_unsupported.context: CPU_MB_CHIPSET, block: the chipset is not in the processor's list; {supported} is a comma-separated list of chipsets

compat.bios_update_flashback.context: CPU_MB_BIOS, warn: the board ships an older BIOS than the processor needs, and the board has BIOS Flashback (update without a processor); BIOS Flashback is the button name and stays in Latin

compat.bios_update_seller.context: CPU_MB_BIOS, warn: as bios_update_flashback, but the board has no Flashback, so the seller has to update the BIOS before assembly

compat.no_video_output.context: CPU_NO_VIDEO, block: no integrated graphics in the processor and no video card in the build; no params

compat.mem_type_board.context: MEM_TYPE, block: the memory type (DDR4 or DDR5) differs from the type of the board

compat.mem_type_cpu.context: MEM_TYPE, block: the processor does not support the memory type; {cpuTypes} is a list like DDR5 or DDR4, DDR5

compat.mem_slots_exceeded.context: MEM_SLOTS, block: more memory modules than slots on the board; both are whole numbers

compat.mem_capacity_exceeded.context: MEM_CAPACITY, block: total memory is above the maximum of the board, gigabytes

compat.mem_speed_reduced.context: MEM_SPEED, warn: the memory is faster than the board or the processor supports; MT/s is megatransfers per second (the usual unit of memory speed)

compat.mem_cooler_clearance.context: MEM_COOLER_CLEARANCE, warn: memory modules taller than the clearance under the air cooler, millimetres

compat.board_not_supported.context: MB_CASE_FORMFACTOR, block: the case does not take this board form factor (ATX, mATX, Mini-ITX, E-ATX); {supported} is a list

compat.gpu_too_long.context: GPU_CASE_LENGTH, block: the card is longer than the case allows, millimetres

compat.gpu_tight_fit.context: GPU_CASE_LENGTH, warn: the card fits, but the spare length (marginMm) is below the warning margin

compat.gpu_slots_exceeded.context: GPU_SLOT_WIDTH, warn: the card is thicker than the expansion slots of the case; the card thickness can be fractional (3.5), so the text has no plural forms

compat.cooler_socket_unsupported.context: COOLER_SOCKET, block: ICU select on {cooler}: air = air cooler, aio = liquid cooling, other = anything else; the select options must stay in Latin

compat.cooler_too_tall.context: COOLER_CASE_HEIGHT, block: the air cooler is taller than the case allows, millimetres

compat.cooler_tight_fit.context: COOLER_CASE_HEIGHT, warn: the cooler fits, but the spare height (marginMm) is below the warning margin

compat.cooler_underpowered.context: COOLER_TDP, warn: the rated dissipation of the cooler is below the maximum power of the processor, watts

compat.aio_no_mount.context: AIO_RADIATOR_MOUNT, block: the case has no mount for a radiator of this size (240, 280, 360, 420)

compat.aio_too_thick.context: AIO_RADIATOR_THICKNESS, warn: the radiator with its fans is thicker than the mount allows, millimetres

compat.psu_below_peak.context: PSU_WATTAGE, block: the rating of the power supply is below the estimated peak of the build, watts

compat.psu_below_recommended.context: PSU_WATTAGE, warn: the rating covers the peak but is below the recommendation (peak x 1.3 rounded up to the series, or the card vendor figure)

compat.psu_low_headroom.context: PSU_WATTAGE, warn: the headroom of the power supply over the estimated peak, (rating - peak) / peak, in whole percent, is below the owner's threshold minPct; with default settings only reachable if the owner lowers the multiplier

compat.psu_8pin_missing.context: PSU_GPU_CONNECTORS, block: the power supply has fewer 8-pin connectors than the card needs; whole numbers

compat.psu_12v2x6_missing.context: PSU_GPU_CONNECTORS, block: the card needs 12V-2x6, the power supply has no native cable and the card has no adapter in the box

compat.psu_12v2x6_adapter.context: PSU_GPU_CONNECTORS, warn: the card connects through the adapter from its own box because the power supply has too few native 12V-2x6 cables

compat.psu_form_factor_unsupported.context: PSU_CASE_FORMFACTOR, block: ATX, SFX or SFX-L power supply that the case does not take; {supported} is a list

compat.psu_too_long.context: PSU_CASE_LENGTH, warn: the power supply is longer than the case allows, millimetres

compat.m2_slots_exceeded.context: M2_SLOTS, block: more NVMe drives than M.2 slots on the board; whole numbers

compat.m2_too_long.context: M2_LENGTH, block: the M.2 drive is longer than the slot allows, millimetres

compat.m2_disables_sata.context: M2_SATA_SHARING, block: an occupied M.2 slot disables SATA ports and the remaining ports are fewer than the SATA drives

compat.sata_ports_exceeded.context: SATA_PORTS, block: more SATA drives than ports on the board; whole numbers

compat.argb_headers_short.context: ARGB_HEADERS, warn: more devices with addressable RGB lighting (5 V) than headers on the board

compat.rgb_headers_short.context: ARGB_HEADERS, warn: more devices with plain RGB lighting (12 V) than headers on the board

compat.fan_mounts_exceeded.context: FAN_HEADERS, block: more fans than fan mounts in the case; whole numbers

compat.fan_headers_short.context: FAN_HEADERS, warn: more fans than fan headers on the board; a splitter solves it

compat.no_wireless.context: WIFI_FOR_TASK, warn: ICU select on {task}: streaming = streaming, office = office work and study, other = any other task; the select options must stay in Latin

compat.monitors_wider_than_desk.context: DESK_WIDTH_MONITORS, block: the monitors placed side by side are wider than the desk top, millimetres

compat.eye_distance_short.context: DESK_DEPTH_EYES, warn: the distance from the eyes to the screen is below the recommended minimum; the desk is too shallow for a monitor on its stand, millimetres

compat.eye_distance_long.context: DESK_DEPTH_EYES, warn: the distance from the eyes to the screen is above the recommended maximum; the desk is too deep for a monitor on its stand, millimetres

compat.arm_vesa_unsupported.context: ARM_VESA, block: the VESA pattern of the monitor (like 100x100) is not in the list of the monitor arm; {armVesa} is a list

compat.arm_monitor_no_vesa.context: ARM_VESA, block: the monitor has no VESA mount; no params

compat.arm_overload.context: ARM_LOAD, block: the monitor is heavier than the arm can carry, kilograms

compat.arm_underload.context: ARM_LOAD, warn: the monitor is lighter than the minimum load of the arm, so the arm cannot hold its position; kilograms

compat.arm_diagonal_out_of_range.context: ARM_DIAGONAL, warn: the monitor diagonal is outside the range of the arm, inches; the dash is an en dash

compat.arm_desk_thickness.context: ARM_DESK_THICKNESS, block: the desk top thickness is outside the range the arm clamps to, millimetres; the dash is an en dash

compat.arm_clamp_over_leg.context: ARM_CLAMP_ZONE, warn: the clamp of the arm sits over a leg of the desk; xMm is the position along the desk, from..to is the leg zone, millimetres

compat.chair_rollback_short.context: CHAIR_ROLLBACK, warn: the free space behind the desk is below the roll-back zone of the chair, millimetres

compat.chair_user_height.context: CHAIR_USER_HEIGHT, warn: the height of the user is outside the range of the chair, centimetres; the dash is an en dash
